short.en: Click a cell, wire it in

t.zh: 机器人一格一格地走过整张表，在每一格上运行同一块<wiki-ref to="board"></wiki-ref>。
t.en: The robot walks through the whole table cell by cell and runs the same <wiki-ref to="board"></wiki-ref> on every cell.

goal.zh: 让机器人把最左边格子里的数一格一格抄到最右边。
goal.en: Have the robot copy the number in the leftmost cell, cell by cell, all the way to the right.

how.zh: 在视野里点「左边」，把它连到「本格」。
how.en: Click “left” in the view and wire it to “this cell”.

body.zh: 电路板就是规则：只写一次，机器人在每一格上都用它。
body.en: The circuit board is the rule: you write it once, and the robot uses it on every cell.

hints.zh: 在视野里点「左边」，再连到「本格」。
hints.en: Click “left” in the view, then wire it to “this cell”.
